en.title: Video Generative Models as Geometry Learners
en.hook: Discover how adapting pretrained diffusion models unlocks powerful 3D geometry estimation capabilities from video data.
key_takeaways: Adapts pretrained image/video diffusion models for geometry estimation tasks
Treats spatial understanding as image-conditioned generation
Significantly improves 3D reconstruction and spatial awareness in CV

zh.title: 将视频生成模型作为几何学习器
zh.hook: 探索如何利用预训练扩散模型，将视频生成转化为强大的3D几何估计任务。
key_takeaways: 将现有的图像/视频扩散模型适配于几何估计任务
把空间理解视为条件图像生成问题
显著提升计算机视觉中的3D重建与空间感知能力
